correctness.rationale: Both nonlinear fixed-point systems are exactly derived from the primary equations; A and B are transposes. A positive 2x2 fixed-point rank lemma is proved by Perron threshold continuation and noncrossing. Each row-sum contrast is factored symbolically, and its roots are reciprocals. Exposed-stage progression is certain. Exact identities and independently solved sample fixed points are checked by embedded verify.py. The conclusion is restricted to supercritical positive branches.

value.rationale: The recent motivating study explicitly asks when a group with highest eventual burden is also the group most likely to seed an outbreak; the sharp whole-parameter two-group phase diagram supplies an exact structural answer and a concrete reciprocal crossover. It is not an arbitrary slice: two balanced groups, opposite trait advantages, and a one-parameter assortative mixing family are the minimal natural setting for that question. Nondependence on intensity and incubation is a useful interpretable structural property; numerical comparisons of individual cities cannot imply it.
